hanebramuseum.name: Nebra Sky Disc
hanebramuseum.slogan: The oldest map of the heavens, kept in Halle.
hanebramuseum.line: Buried around 1600 BCE and found in 1999, the 2.2 kg bronze disc joined UNESCO's Memory of the World in 2013.

habauhaus.name: Bauhaus Dessau
habauhaus.slogan: A glass wall three storeys tall, drawn by Gropius.
habauhaus.line: Opened on 4 December 1926, its workshop wing hangs a glass curtain wall in front of its supporting columns.

hahaendelhaus.name: Handel House
hahaendelhaus.slogan: Where young Georg Friedrich first heard music in the walls.
hahaendelhaus.line: Handel was born here on 23 February 1685 and lived in the house until he left for Hamburg in 1703.

hageburtshaus.name: Luther's Birth House
hageburtshaus.slogan: Half-timbered rooms where the Reformation's loudest voice began.
hageburtshaus.line: After a fire in 1689 the upper storey was rebuilt, and by 1693 the house had opened as a museum for pilgrims.

hamarktkirche.name: Marktkirche
hamarktkirche.slogan: Four spires and a Red Tower: Halle's skyline in one square.
hamarktkirche.line: Built from 1529 to 1554 on two older churches, it is where Handel was baptised in 1685.
